inline_text:
Related to #30

## Scope

Taxonomy only: `workstreams/taxonomy/terms.md`

## What

Replace `Workflow Step / Workflow Task` with `Activity`.
Define Activity before Workflow and update related taxonomy definitions.

## Why

The working group agreed to use “Activity” instead of “Step”.
Defining Activity independently avoids a circular definition with Workflow.
